chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Ibn Al-Arzamy, from his father, from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said:
He said: The essence (athafiyy) of Islam is three: Salat, Zakat, and Wilayah. Not one of them is valid except with its two companions.
ai.seo_question: What are the three essential pillars of Islam according to Imam Al-Sadiq in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates Wilayah to the status of a fundamental pillar of Islam, equal in validity to Salat and Zakat. This triad underscores the Shia theological view that divine authority (Wilayah) is the spiritual foundation that validates the ritual acts of prayer and charity, ensuring their acceptance. The interdependence highlights that true Islam requires both outward observance and inward recognition of divine leadership.
